scope: Closed dcfc-to-4cd full-browser qualification. All six terminal primary and original raw evidence layers are complete; no new acquisition or source modification.

registeredPlan.timer: File input through completion of required post-UI work; uninstrumented complete-import timing.

decision.reason: Both separately provisioned VNDB hosts miss the frozen minimum 2% paired median reduction, 9-of-12 faster pairs and below-zero descriptive 95% interval. Identical-code control variation is larger than both candidate medians.
decision.nonTargetInterpretation: All four non-target intervals cross zero. No replicated mechanical rejection signal is present; these inconclusive timings do not prove equivalence or non-regression.

sourcePolicyFiles.scope: Read-only independent current-base source binding for the unchanged frozen audit policy

durableReferences.note: All listed files already exist in the parent evidence tree or the exact frozen source commit. Referenced hashes are preserved; copies are omitted from this new payload.

correctnessScope.interpretation: Original compiled-artifact CI passed; the subsequent exact-source reuse gate binds those tested six product bytes to 4cd. Exact-head actionlint is separately recorded.

recoveryHistory.scope: Read-only post-acquisition log recovery; original bytes and failed first attempt retained.

preservation.omittedReleasePackages: Only the original producer exclusions package-A.zip and package-B.zip per cell; their exact byte hashes/sizes and all 554 entry hashes remain retained.
preservation.newProvenanceTarArchives: Deterministic lossless storage representations with original member SHA-256/byte lengths; no unavailable old archive identity is assigned.

limits: No host pooling, control subtraction, outlier removal, retry, or source/threshold changes.
